description: Ministry of Public Administration - Notify the amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, specifically detailing recruitment procedures, examination requirements, and selection methods for public service positions. It focuses on public sector recruitment processes, examination structures, and Public Service Commission procedures, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover public service recruitment, examinations, and service conditions.
